headline: Waymo has opened its driverless taxi service to every resident of San Antonio, San Diego and Tampa, including airport rides in San Antonio.
score_reason: Fresh 14 Oct 2026 expansion by the biggest US robotaxi operator; facts match the headline, but it comes from the company's own announcement.
importance_line: Anyone in three more US cities, including travellers at San Antonio's airport, can now ride a driverless car without an invitation, though the safety and ride figures come from Waymo itself.
summary: Unite.AI reports, citing Waymo's announcement, that the company opened its fully autonomous ride-hailing service to the general public in San Antonio, San Diego and Tampa on 14 Oct 2026, so anyone in those cities can now download the Waymo app and book a ride. Until now access in these cities was by invitation, and the opening includes fully autonomous rides at San Antonio International Airport; Waymo says it has already carried hundreds of thousands of riders in the three cities, a figure we cannot check independently.
notes: Read Unite.AI (AI-generated byline, reviewed by its editors); original is Waymo's announcement.
